name: instantly-gtm
description: Run the full cold-email outbound loop on top of Instantly: find leads, write sequences, launch campaigns, triage replies, check performance.

shortcuts.description: Turn an ICP into a verified prospect list (steps 1-2).
Draft a cold-email sequence in your voice (step 3).
Assemble a draft and launch it safely (steps 4-5).
Triage the inbox, draft responses, book meetings (step 6).
Pull analytics, chart, and suggest the next change (step 7).
View your sending accounts/DFY orders, check capacity, and buy DFY mailboxes/domains (simulate then confirm).
